nv_connection=$(curl -q --fail --silent --show-error --noproxy '*' --proxy '' --max-time 4 --unix-socket '<socket-dir>/agents.sock' 'http://localhost/profiles/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222') || {
  printf '%s\n' 'Open nonstopvibin and start personal.' >&2
  exit 1
}
nv_key=${nv_connection%%'
'*}
nv_port=${nv_connection#*'
'}
case "$nv_key" in nv_*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
case "$nv_key" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_-]*) exit 1 ;; esac
[ "${#nv_key}" -eq 46 ] || exit 1
[ "$nv_port" = '4318' ] || {
  printf '%s\n' 'The gateway port changed. Reconnect this agent in nonstopvibin.' >&2
  exit 1
}
printf '%s\n' "$nv_key"
"
}
